remaining_known_limitations: WRC pvalue over delay variants is not available on disk; recomputing it requires persisting delay-shifted per-fold PnLs, which is deferred.
N = 8 folds limits statistical power. Paired-bootstrap CIs remain wide.
Rolling-window PFs with n < 30 trades are denominator-driven and should not be interpreted as evidence of persistent edge.
Stacking's paired-bootstrap ΔPF lower bound of ≈ -55 is a numerical artifact caused by near-zero per-fold gross losses on at least one fold — flagged in the report but not corrected numerically.
Phase 7 does not retrain models. ±1 fold shift is implemented as edge-fold drop, not re-splitting the training window.
Slippage and tcost stress reuse the analytical round_trip_cost decomposition; a gap or jump-diffusion overlay would require real re-simulation with a different fill model.
